protocol.observer: simulation truth; mechanism evidence, no real-car validation
protocol.world: independent horizontal Bullet plane; gravity -9.81; no window
protocol.comparison: same mode car, initial conditions, controls, load exponents and K/b; A compliance false, B true; ABS/TCS/ESC all true
protocol.initialization: once-only speed/pure rolling, airborne +2m or coast yaw +.5rad/s; no runtime edits
protocol.energy_phase: deformation, elastic_energy and force_patch_kappa/alpha are final tire substep at force_contact_tick; force_kappa/alpha same force phase; kappa/alpha are completed Bullet observations at sample_tick
protocol.dissipation: material/road/elastic_numerical/frame fields are Joules summed over tire substeps within one tick; trial sums exclude initial row; no positivity clamp
protocol.energy_scope: contact storage/dissipation only; not complete chassis/engine/brake/collision energy balance; maximum energy is not time-summed
protocol.mode_energy: per-wheel dissipation sums and storage/deformation/force-patch/force-wheel/completed-wheel slip maxima across selected independent trials; not one continuous drive
protocol.outcomes: retain all raw trajectories and deltas; no enforced acceleration, distance or yaw improvement
